title: Mingo Plus
subtitle: Compare calmly. The free plan stays whole for the essentials.
activeText: Thank you. Everything is unlocked for you and your partner.
paidByPartner: Your partner has Plus and it covers you both.

plusFeatures: Unlimited games, rituals and lists, more chats with the mascot and more for both of you, covering you and your partner.

partnerCancel: If either partner cancels, Plus ends for both, with a clear notice.
